title: 恐龙爱泡泡浴
subtitle: 千万别放会叫的小黄鸭
character: wearing light blue pyjamas with short sleeves, short black hair
style: children's picture book illustration, loose sketchy pencil lines with soft transparent watercolour washes, lots of plain white paper around the figures, muted faded colours, simple rounded characters with small dot eyes and calm deadpan expressions, no words, no letters and no writing anywhere in the picture, soft aqua, lilac and warm orange

pages.zh:
嘿，小朋友。
你知道恐龙最爱干什么吗？
pages.scene: A medium shot of the little boy seen from his knees up, holding a toy dinosaur, looking curious, his face turned towards the viewer, drawn with the natural body proportions of a real five-year-old child, his head in proportion to his body and about one fifth of his height, not a big-headed cartoon, his eyes calm and natural

pages.zh:
不是吼。
也不是跑。
pages.scene: One of the soft rounded friendly cartoon dinosaurs with small dot eyes standing with a bored face, arms hanging, on white paper

pages.zh: 是泡泡浴。
pages.scene: One of the soft rounded friendly cartoon dinosaurs with small dot eyes sitting in an old bathtub full of bubbles, eyes half closed, blissful

pages.zh: 大泡泡。
pages.scene: One of the soft rounded friendly cartoon dinosaurs with small dot eyes blowing one enormous bubble

pages.zh: 小泡泡。
pages.scene: A small one of the soft rounded friendly cartoon dinosaurs with small dot eyes surrounded by hundreds of tiny bubbles

pages.zh:
能把一整只恐龙装进去的
超级大泡泡。
pages.scene: One of the soft rounded friendly cartoon dinosaurs with small dot eyes floating calmly inside a giant clear bubble

pages.zh: 它们用泡泡做胡子。
pages.scene: One of the soft rounded friendly cartoon dinosaurs with small dot eyes with a big white beard made of foam

pages.zh: 做帽子，做皇冠。
pages.scene: Three of the soft rounded friendly cartoon dinosaurs with small dot eyes wearing tall hats and crowns made of foam

pages.zh:
三角龙喜欢把泡泡
堆在三只角上。
pages.scene: A triceratops in a bathtub with foam piled up on its three horns

pages.zh:
长脖子恐龙喜欢泡到
只剩一个脑袋。
pages.scene: A long-necked dinosaur in a very deep tub, only its head above the foam

pages.zh:
霸王龙的手太短了，
搓不到背。
pages.scene: A T. rex in a bathtub stretching its tiny arms and failing to reach its back

pages.zh:
所以它每次泡澡，
都要请朋友帮忙。
pages.scene: A triceratops scrubbing a T. rex's back with a long brush in the bath

pages.zh:
要是你想请恐龙来家里，
就放一大缸泡泡水。
pages.scene: A medium shot of the little boy seen from his knees up, pouring bubble liquid into a big bathtub, sleeves pushed up, his face turned towards the viewer, drawn with the natural body proportions of a real five-year-old child, his head in proportion to his body and about one fifth of his height, not a big-headed cartoon, his eyes calm and natural

pages.zh: 越满越好。
pages.scene: A bathtub overflowing with foam spilling onto the floor, nobody in the picture

pages.zh: 不过，你一定要记住一件事。
pages.scene: One small yellow rubber duck alone on white paper

pages.zh:
千万不能放
会叫的小黄鸭。
pages.scene: One of the soft rounded friendly cartoon dinosaurs with small dot eyes peeking nervously from far away at a small yellow rubber duck

pages.zh:
恐龙什么都不怕。
不怕打雷，也不怕黑。
pages.scene: One of the soft rounded friendly cartoon dinosaurs with small dot eyes sitting calmly under a dark stormy sky, unbothered

pages.zh: 就怕那一声吱。
pages.scene: A small yellow rubber duck in the middle, the soft rounded friendly cartoon dinosaurs with small dot eyes around it frozen with wide eyes

pages.zh:
它们一听见，
就会吓得跳起来，
到处乱跑。
pages.scene: The soft rounded friendly cartoon dinosaurs with small dot eyes leaping and running off in every direction

pages.zh:
所以，小黄鸭，
放到别的地方去。
pages.scene: A medium shot of the little boy seen from his knees up, reaching up to put a yellow rubber duck on a high shelf, his face turned towards the viewer, drawn with the natural body proportions of a real five-year-old child, his head in proportion to his body and about one fifth of his height, not a big-headed cartoon, his eyes calm and natural

pages.zh:
星期六晚上，他决定
办一个泡泡浴派对。
pages.scene: A medium shot of the little boy seen from his knees up, standing in a bathroom beside a big old bathtub, towels over his arm, his face turned towards the viewer, drawn with the natural body proportions of a real five-year-old child, his head in proportion to his body and about one fifth of his height, not a big-headed cartoon, his eyes calm and natural

pages.zh:
他放了满满一缸水，
倒了一整瓶泡泡液。
pages.scene: A medium shot of the little boy seen from his knees up, pouring a big bottle into the bath while foam rises high, his face turned towards the viewer, drawn with the natural body proportions of a real five-year-old child, his head in proportion to his body and about one fifth of his height, not a big-headed cartoon, his eyes calm and natural

pages.zh: 恐龙一只一只挤进来。
pages.scene: The soft rounded friendly cartoon dinosaurs with small dot eyes squeezing through a bathroom doorway one after another

pages.zh:
它们泡得眯起了眼睛。
舒服极了。
pages.scene: A medium shot of the little boy seen from his knees up, sitting on the edge of the bathtub while the soft rounded friendly cartoon dinosaurs with small dot eyes soak packed together in the foam, eyes closed, his face turned towards the viewer, drawn with the natural body proportions of a real five-year-old child, his head in proportion to his body and about one fifth of his height, not a big-headed cartoon, his eyes calm and natural

pages.zh:
可是，谁也没有发现，
泡泡底下，
漂着一只小黄鸭。
pages.scene: A close view of foam with a small yellow rubber duck half hidden underneath

pages.zh: 一只恐龙坐了下去——
pages.scene: A large one of the soft rounded friendly cartoon dinosaurs with small dot eyes lowering itself slowly into the foam

pages.zh: 吱！
pages.scene: A flattened yellow rubber duck under a dinosaur's bottom, the dinosaur's eyes huge

pages.zh: 恐龙全跳起来了！
pages.scene: The soft rounded friendly cartoon dinosaurs with small dot eyes leaping out of the bathtub, foam flying everywhere

pages.zh:
泡泡飞出窗户，飞满客厅，
一直涨到天花板。
pages.scene: A living room filled with foam up to the ceiling, dinosaur tails poking out of it

pages.zh:
他在泡泡里摸呀摸，
摸到了那只小黄鸭。
他把它捏住，不让它叫了。
pages.scene: A medium shot of the little boy seen from his knees up, standing waist-deep in foam holding a yellow rubber duck tightly in both hands, his face turned towards the viewer, drawn with the natural body proportions of a real five-year-old child, his head in proportion to his body and about one fifth of his height, not a big-headed cartoon, his eyes calm and natural

pages.zh:
大家把泡泡搬到后院，
吹出一个比房子还大的泡泡。
pages.scene: A medium shot of the little boy seen from his knees up, in the backyard with the soft rounded friendly cartoon dinosaurs with small dot eyes beside a giant bubble bigger than the house, his face turned towards the viewer, drawn with the natural body proportions of a real five-year-old child, his head in proportion to his body and about one fifth of his height, not a big-headed cartoon, his eyes calm and natural

pages.zh:
现在你知道了：
恐龙爱泡泡浴，不爱会叫的鸭子。
今天晚上洗澡的时候，你也看看，
泡泡里有没有一只小恐龙。
pages.scene: A medium shot of the little boy seen from his knees up, kneeling beside a bathtub with one hand in the foam, a tiny dinosaur peeking out of the bubbles, his face turned towards the viewer, drawn with the natural body proportions of a real five-year-old child, his head in proportion to his body and about one fifth of his height, not a big-headed cartoon, his eyes calm and natural
